utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When are we starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think I heard it's supposed to start next weekend, but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who's organizing it? I need to know the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a shed full of tools that might come in handy if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. Yeah, that'd be great, I think. I keep forgetting what I need, though.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, why don't you swing by my place later and take a look? I've got everything from wrenches to saws.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old appliances for free.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, really? That sounds nice, but I wonder if they have enough parts and people to handle all the requests. Did they sign up beforehand?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, they did! I saw a sign-up sheet at the community center—they're asking folks to drop off their broken items by Friday so they can sort through everything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need a hand setting things up or sorting through the donations?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Sam, I could really use your help! I'm trying to coordinate drop-off spots around the neighborhood—got a map to fill in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with that! I know a few good spots—just show me the map and I'll mark them down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli! I’m organizing a repair drive for the old playground equipment this Saturday. You in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, the playground... sure, I can come by for a bit. Might be good to keep my hands busy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! I’ll spread the word to the rest of the block. Let’s make this a fun community thing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Leo! I was just thinking about the repair drive—how are we doing on volunteers for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help for a few hours in the morning. What else is needed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Leo! Could you focus on bike repairs? We have a few people signed up for electronics already.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive, right? Did you get a chance to look at the error log before we start?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I just got here. Haven't had a chance to check it yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, no worries—let's take a quick look at it together before we dig into anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think the repair drive should be on Saturday to avoid conflicting with school events.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday sounds good to me—I can bring my toolbox and help with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll set up a sign-up sheet for volunteers and make sure we have enough supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, I heard something about a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, yeah! It's a neighborhood thing where we all pitch in to fix up folks' stuff—tools, furniture, even appliances. I'm helping organize it!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds awesome! I've got a wobbly chair and a broken toaster—would those count for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I saw something about that in the group chat—didn't read the whole thing though.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're not sure what it actually is? Can you check the chat again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I can try to scroll back, but honestly my phone's blowing up with work stuff right now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Is the repair drive still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive? Hmm, let me think—I'm pretty sure I left a flyer about it somewhere on my counter.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you check the flyer? I'd like to know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I heard we're doing that repair drive this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, that's right! I've been sorting through the spare parts and tools we've got. Should be enough to help a few folks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll tell the folks on Birch Street about it — they've got a few broken fences needing attention.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, what's this I hear about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I'm not sure, I haven't heard about it. What's it for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's to raise funds to fix the community center roof—it's been leaking pretty bad after the last storm.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hey, Vik! The repair drive... wait, was that today or tomorrow? I always mix those up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's tomorrow, Oren! I heard from Maria that it starts at 10 AM sharp down at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tomorrow, right, right. I'll put a note on my fridge this time so I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Leo, what's this about a repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm collecting broken tools to fix up this weekend. Got any?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I might have a rusty wrench somewhere... let me check my garage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools I could lend out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's great, Gus. I appreciate the offer. Can you tell me exactly what tools you have so I can plan accordingly?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing! I've got a solid drill, a level, a couple of hammers, and a set of wrenches that should cover most jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Quinn! I’m so glad you stopped by—are we still on for organizing the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I've already told half the block—they're thrilled to help out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Fantastic! Let's meet Friday evening to sort through the tools everyone's donating.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—sounds like a great way to bring the neighborhood together!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules! I'm trying to get everyone to pitch in tools and time. Do you know who might have a good set of wrenches?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, definitely check with Marcus down the street—he's got a whole garage full of tools and loves helping out with stuff like this.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Cleo, I'm so glad you stopped by! I wanted to talk about organizing a community repair drive for the weekend—what do you think?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds like a great idea! I can help with sorting and listing the supplies we have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's perfect! I was hoping you'd say that—your organizational skills are exactly what we need to get this off the ground.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I heard there's a repair drive happening soon — do you know when it's set for?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I think it's this Saturday at the community center. You planning on bringing something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I don't have anything broken myself, but I thought I'd stop by to see what it's all about — maybe lend a hand if they need it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, did you get the flyer about that repair drive this weekend? Think it's on Saturday or Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, I saw it! I think it's Saturday, but honestly I'm still trying to figure out if I can squeeze it in between dropping off the kids and grocery shopping.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, pretty sure it's Saturday. I'm just gonna drop by with my toaster, see if they can fix it quick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira! I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need a hand setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? I'm not sure I'm the one organizing it—are you sure you've got the right person?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, my mistake! I thought you were the one, but I'd still love to help if you know who's running it.
